decision.title: Clang is the compiler sxml is checked with; GCC is not
decision.summary: The definition of done, the packet gate, the release checklist and CI build with Clang only; the debug-gcc preset is removed, and a warning only GCC gives is not a defect.

body.p: The owner (2026-11-27): Clang is the blessed compiler. Building every change with GCC as well doubled the verification time for no defect a user had reported; packet 8.17 had added a GCC step to the EXI gate after GCC's -Wmissing-braces refused a {0} initializer that Clang accepts.

item.p: The definition of done (CLAUDE.md) asks for -Werror under Clang. The packet gate (tools/exi/check-packet.sh), the release checklist (RELEASE), tools/check-main.sh and tools/private-build.sh build with Clang presets only, and the debug-gcc preset is removed.
The book's C chapters build with clang, so their examples do not depend on the reader's cc.
The WASI SDK and the Android NDK are Clang; MSVC stays as it is.
CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) is a short check on Clang, as the owner asked, to spend few Actions minutes; the CPU-heavy verification (sanitizers, conformance, fuzzing) runs elsewhere.
